fonts.usage: H1, H2, large display numbers, prominent CTAs
fonts.characteristics: Heavy, industrial, bold, uppercase by default. Represents the 'Trusted, Modern, Bold' transport aesthetic.

fonts.usage: Body text, small labels, form inputs, navigation links
fonts.characteristics: Clean, geometric sans-serif. Highly readable for data and dense text.

colors.strategy: Dark cinematic mode. The UI should feel like a premium command center or high-end industrial brochure. Almost entirely deep black/charcoal backgrounds. Use the Red (#C81010) strictly for primary CTA buttons and active states. Use Gold (#D4AF37) for premium accents like subtle icons or section dividers. Use Silver (#C0C0C0) for faint 1px structural borders.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders (border-[#C0C0C0]/15) to separate dark elements rather than drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Sharp or minimal. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm (2px). Do not use heavily rounded corners; it dilutes the industrial feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Cinematic dark overlays on imagery (bg-black/40 to bg-black/60) to ensure high text contrast. Grain overlay on pure black backgrounds if possible to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.interactions: Hover states on cards should subtly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase border brightness. Buttons should have a strong hover state (color shift or subtle glow).

layouts.structure: Grid-based, generous spacing (p-12, p-24). Avoid cramped sections. Let images and large typography breathe.
layouts.hero: Full-bleed background image with heavy dark gradient overlay. Large Bebas Neue headline, clean Manrope sub-headline, solid Red CTA.
layouts.services: Bento-style or strict 4-column grid for the services. Sharp edges, 1px silver-tinted borders.
layouts.about: Asymmetric layout. 2 columns: Text/Story on one side, a tight grid of the 2 owner photos on the other.
layouts.contact: 2-column layout: Form on the left, Contact details (WhatsApp, Phone) on the right.

motion.philosophy: Purposeful, heavy, and premium. No bouncy or overly fast animations.
motion.libraries: framer-motion for scroll reveals, pure CSS for hover states.
effects: Staggered fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0) for lists and service cards.
Parallax effect on the signature drone shot background.
Smooth accordion for any expandable details.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#C81010] text-white hover:bg-[#A00D0D]. Secondary: transparent with border border-[#C0C0C0]/30 text-white hover:border-white.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Dark background (bg-[#141414]), sharp corners, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C81010].
components.cards: Dark surfaces (bg-[#141414] or transparent), 1px border-[#C0C0C0]/15, sharp corners. Images inside cards should have a subtle zoom on hover.

fabrication_guardrails: DO NOT invent fleet size (e.g., '50+ trucks').
DO NOT invent years in business (e.g., 'Since 1990').
DO NOT invent awards or certifications.
DO NOT invent pricing or delivery guarantees.
DO NOT invent specific service locations beyond 'Nationwide/Interstate/Local'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Bebas Neue for all H1/H2 tags and CTAs, with heavy tracking. Stick to a strict dark mode palette. Do NOT round container corners (use rounded-none or rounded-sm at most). Ensure all text is perfectly legible over images using bg-black/60 or similar overlays. Build the About section carefully featuring the two local owner photos provided. Hook up the form to POST /api/enquiries. DO NOT invent any company statistics or testimonials.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'
Do not use generic AI emojis.
Use glass-morphism sparingly; rely more on solid dark colors with 1px silver borders for this industrial brand.
Ensure hover states exist for all clickable elements.
